It fits none of the five documented patterns: there is no low-value testing run and no new region.

sar.narrative: On or about 2016-11-22 02:30:00, financial institution detection systems identified suspicious activity associated with account holder C07297 on card C07297-K1. Transaction 3476682 in the amount of $482.12 was executed via the online channel (C). The transaction exhibited significant anomalies including 7.6x deviation from historical median spending and novel device profile infrastructure (Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080). Contact was initiated with the cardholder, who confirmed that the transaction was unauthorized and executed without their consent. The identified activity represents confirmed undocumented with total unauthorized exposure of $1906.07. In accordance with federal Bank Secrecy Act and Suspicious Activity Reporting guidelines, the compromised card has been placed under permanent block and scheduled for reissue, and all connected network entities are subject to ongoing monitoring.
